payload.reason: The evidence discusses methods for evaluating and improving the quality of singing voice through various techniques, including pitch manipulation and conversion methods, which can be quantitatively assessed using metrics like Mean Opinion Score (MOS).

claims.text: The quality of singing voice can be measured using Mean Opinion Score (MOS), which evaluates the quality of converted singing voices.
Singing voice quality is affected by pitch accuracy, which can be controlled during generation to improve the overall quality of the singing voice.
Singing voice conversion methods aim to produce high-quality outputs by addressing challenges in pitch and phonetic representation.
